Every entry with a non-null youtubeVideoId was verified by fetching https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id> and recording the title that came back in verifiedTitle + verificationEvidence. An entry with no trustworthy exact match keeps youtubeVideoId null and status NEEDS_REVIEW — a wrong video is worse than none. Regenerate the TS with: npm run build:exercise-video-registry
_rules: NEVER add a youtubeVideoId that was not fetched and confirmed — the build fails without verifiedTitle/verifiedAt/verificationEvidence.
status APPROVED requires a verified id AND matchConfidence high|medium.
No video is downloaded or re-hosted. This registry stores a reference only.
Prefer reputable instructional channels; reject clickbait, compilations and rehosts.
